meta.title: Halkhata — বলুন, দোকান সাজান
meta.description: Speak your shelf into a shop. Say "চাল ১ কেজি ১০০" and the item is listed, priced and live — in Bangla, Hindi or English. Customers order from a counter QR, and the order lands in your app.
meta.bodyText:
Halkhata

দোকান সাজান মুখে বলে

“চাল ১ কেজি ১০০”

বলুন — জিনিসটা দামসহ তালিকায় উঠে গেল, খদ্দের দেখতে পেল।
বাংলা, হিন্দি বা ইংরেজিতে। টাইপ করতে হবে না।

Customers scan the QR at your counter and the order lands in your app — with a bell that counts it from every screen. No login, no training.

দাম দ

meta.title: Halkhata — Pricing
meta.description: One price per shop, by how many items you sell. No commission on orders.
h1: One price per shop.Never a cut of your orders.
meta.bodyText:
HALKHATA

One price per shop.
Never a cut of your orders.

You pay for how many items you list — nothing else. Orders, customers and QR scans are unlimited on every plan, because charging a shop more for selling more is not a partnership.

Start on WhatsApp
See the plans
0%
commission on every order
